title: Microwave-treated SCOBY residue blind identity and process-history gate
source_context: Continuation of the SCOBY-D0 carbonaceous-material hypothesis after review of v2.5. This revision converts the line into a blind material-identity and process-history gate before structural, functional, or application claims are admitted.
scope: Materials-science hypothesis generation and evidence-gating only; not a validated synthesis protocol, device recipe, agricultural recommendation, food product, or safety-approved procedure.

material_identity_gate.admission_rule: No application class may be assigned as an accepted material property before blind material-identity characterization is completed.
material_identity_gate.blindness_rule: Where feasible, analysts performing identity characterization must not be given the originating application hypothesis or expected performance ranking before primary identity measurements are recorded.
material_identity_gate.anti_confirmation_bias_rule: Application-specific tests may begin only after the identity gate records a provisional material class and preserves competing explanations.

thermal_history.claim_rule: Thermal history must be measured or independently reconstructed where possible; nominal equipment settings are not substitutes for sample temperature history.

microwave_metadata.claim_rule: Microwave treatment conditions must be treated as experimental variables, not as a generic category of exposure.

BET_reproducibility.claim_rule: BET surface area and pore metrics are inadmissible as portable comparison values without method metadata sufficient to reproduce the measurement.

reproducibility_gate.minimum_exploratory_replication: At least three independently prepared samples per treatment condition before making comparative material claims.
reproducibility_gate.rule: n=3 is a minimum exploratory replication gate and must not be represented as sufficient statistical evidence for strong quantitative generalization.

functional_gate.claim_rule: Every electrochemical performance claim must state the normalization basis, electrode configuration, mass loading, current density or scan rate, voltage window, electrolyte and relevant controls.

claim_corrections: The term carbonized is not admitted as a material identity until supported by characterization.
A glassy or brittle appearance does not establish an aerogel, nanoporous carbon, activated carbon, graphite-like carbon, or biochar.
Kitchen-microwave exposure normally occurs in air unless oxygen conditions are deliberately controlled; absence of oxygen must never be assumed.
Microwave settings are not equivalent to sample temperature history.
SCOBY composition varies with fermentation conditions and is not interchangeable with purified bacterial cellulose without qualification.

safety_boundary.microwave_warning: Do not treat this record as an instruction to microwave wet biological material. Rapid heating, steam generation, arcing, ignition and uncontrolled thermal decomposition are possible.
safety_boundary.powder_warning: Carbonaceous powders may present inhalation hazards and require appropriate laboratory containment and handling.
safety_boundary.electrochemical_warning: Improvised electrochemical cells are not validated batteries and require appropriate electrical, electrolyte and containment controls.
safety_boundary.soil_warning: Plant-use claims require testing for pH, salts, organics, ash and contaminants before application.
safety_boundary.food_boundary: This branch is not a food, beverage or human-consumption pathway.

decision_logic.gate_1: UNKNOWN_SAMPLE -> do not assign application class.
decision_logic.gate_2: BLIND_MATERIAL_IDENTITY -> identify composition and transformation state while preserving competing hypotheses.
decision_logic.gate_3: STRUCTURE -> characterize morphology, porosity, density and surface chemistry without importing application expectations.
decision_logic.gate_4: FUNCTION -> test electrical, artistic or soil-relevant functions only with application-appropriate controls.
decision_logic.gate_5: REPRODUCIBILITY -> replicate independent preparations and preserve treatment metadata.
decision_logic.gate_6: APPLICATION_SPECIFIC_VALIDATION -> compare against relevant benchmarks and report normalized metrics.
decision_logic.gate_7: CLAIM -> elevate claim level only when evidence crosses the relevant gate.

next_gate: EXECUTE_OR_REGISTER_A_BLIND_MATERIAL_IDENTITY_AND_PROCESS-HISTORY DATASET WITHOUT APPLICATION-BASED EXPECTATION; REQUIRE COMPLETE THERMAL/MICROWAVE METADATA; THEN ADMIT STRUCTURE CHARACTERIZATION; ONLY AFTER IDENTITY AND STRUCTURE GATES PASS MAY APPLICATION-SPECIFIC FUNCTIONAL TESTING PROCEED.
authority_rule: This record supersedes neither v2.5 evidence nor earlier SCOBY-D0 claims. It is a process and admission gate that constrains future evidence interpretation and prevents application classification from preceding material identity.
